Cloudflare’s OHTTP Gateway is now in closed beta, with one notable restriction: it won’t decrypt requests from Cloudflare Workers or Cloudflare-proxied hosts.

Why? To prevent client identifiers and request contents from ending up in the same hands.

🔎 Learn more: https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/10/cloudflare-ohttp-gateway/
